mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(d.amount AS DECIMAL(36, 12))), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(d.commission_total AS DECIMAL(36, 12))), 0) AS total_commission FROM ( SELECT id, balance_id FROM order_balance ${ew.customSqlSegment} ) b LEFT JOIN order_balance_detail d ON d.balance_id = b.balance_id
